page_title: LEV 2-1 PAU | Bayer Leverkusen v St. Pauli 07/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' The booking goes to Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli).
90+1' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Andreas Nielsen Albers (St. Pauli), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Alexander Blessin has decided to make a change. Andreas Nielsen Albers (St. Pauli) replaces Johannes Eggestein.
89' Substitution. David Nemeth makes way for Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli).
89' Here is a change. Manolis Saliakas is going off and Alexander Blessin gives the last tactical orders to Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli).
89' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
87' Substitution. Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) in, Nathan Tella out.
86' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

84' 2 - 1 Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Lukas Hradecky is just a bystander as the ball flies under the crossbar. The score is 2:1.
83' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle and it's Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
83' The attendance for today's match is 30000.
82' Alexander Blessin has decided to substitute Oladapo Afolayan and he is replaced by Erik Ahlstrand (St. Pauli).
81' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
80' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
79' It's time for a substitution. Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) comes on in place of Carlo Boukhalfa.
79' Xabi Alonso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Florian Wirtz.
78' Substitution. Alejandro Grimaldo walks off the pitch and Jeanuel Belocian (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as a substitute.
75' Today's referee Matthias Jollenbeck rightly decides to book Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) for his harsh tackle.
72' Good clearance! Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayer Leverkusen comes to nothing.
70' Bayer Leverkusen fail to score from a corner as Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli) leaps to collect the ball. Bayer Leverkusen will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

69' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
67' St. Pauli take a short corner kick.

66' Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to St. Pauli.
66' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Edmond Tapsoba, but Nikola Vasilj displays great awareness to stop him.
63' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
61' St. Pauli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
60' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Exequiel Palacios as he is replaced by Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen).
59' The ball finds it way to Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) inside the box and his first-time shot flies a whisker past the right post.
57' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a chip pass into the box, but Nikola Vasilj is quickest to intercept the ball.
55' A dangerous towering header by Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
55' St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick.
54' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) watches the corner all the way, but places his header a whisker wide of the right post from close range.
54' Now St. Pauli have a corner.
50' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is flagged for offside.
46' The game is interrupted as Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) is flagged offside.
46' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Bayer Leverkusen due to an offside in the build-up play.
44' Wait! Referee Matthias Jollenbeck has indicated he is going to review the Bayer Leverkusen goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
44' Granit Xhaka passes to Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen), who gets one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy grounds the keeper and he has a simple task lifting the ball over him into the net.
41' Bayer Leverkusen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
41' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. It will be a corner kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
40' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
37' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
37' The foul by Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Matthias Jollenbeck.
34' Bayer Leverkusen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
33' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
33' The ball is cleared after Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayer Leverkusen are going to take it.
31' Dangerous play by Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen). Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Lukas Hradecky blocks Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli)'s effort from the edge of the box.
28' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
27' Bayer Leverkusen hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
21' 2 - 0 Gooal! Aleix Garcia takes over corner duties. Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the right side of the net. 2:0.
21' The referee blows his whistle, Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
21' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to convert the free kick after the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
20' Referee Matthias Jollenbeck sees the trip by David Nemeth (St. Pauli) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
18' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
15' A free kick into the box, taken by Eric Smith (St. Pauli), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
14' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Matthias Jollenbeck signals. St. Pauli are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
11' The corner is swung in but Bayer Leverkusen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
10' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
8' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Granit Xhaka tees up Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the left side of the goal. 1:0.
6' A quickly taken corner by Bayer Leverkusen.
4' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
4' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle after Carlo Boukhalfa (St. Pauli) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
St. Pauli will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Matthias Jollenbeck.
